LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_Fertility.label: Sex slave specialization (Broodmother)
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_Fertility.description: Her body is ripening for gestation—the lower belly growing softer and fuller by the day, a maternal allure gradually rising in every gesture. The corrupted womb is being mastered bit by bit, conceiving ever more solely by her master's will.
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_Fertility_Final.label: Sex slave specialization (Ultimate broodmother)
LanguageData.SSC_Hediff_Fertility_Final.description: Her body is wholly possessed by the instinct to breed—breasts swollen and full, lower belly warm, the whole of her steeped in a ripened, lascivious air. The corrupted womb is utterly submissive to its master, ready at any moment to receive and to gestate.
